propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store at `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) across CI runs for trend analysis.
The `write_snapshot(dict)` function appends a timestamped record to the NDJSON file; `read_snapshots(since, until)` returns records within a date range.

The snapshot file must be tracked in git (under `.rebar/`, not `reports/`) by adding `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` negation to `.gitignore` so it is not silently ignored by the blanket `.rebar/*` rule.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines must be skipped gracefully without raising exceptions, allowing valid records to remain readable.
Unit tests must verify write/read round-trip within date range, range filtering exclusion, and graceful handling of corrupt lines.
